};

vector<Edge> edges;
const int MAXN = 14043;
vector<int> graph[MAXN];

long long total_cost = 0;
long long dist[MAXN];
int parent[MAXN], parent_edge[MAXN], in_queue[MAXN];

const long long INF = 1e18;
int source = MAXN - 2;
int sink = MAXN - 1;

int remaining_capacity(int x) {
    return edges[x].c - edges[x].f;
}

void augment_flow() {
    for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
        dist[i] = INF;
        parent[i] = -1;
        parent_edge[i] = -1;
        in_queue[i] = 0;
    }
    dist[source] = 0;
    queue<int> q;
    q.push(source);
    in_queue[source] = 1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int node = q.front();
        q.pop();
        in_queue[node] = 0;
        for (auto edge_idx : graph[node]) {
            if (remaining_capacity(edge_idx) == 0) continue;
            int cost_c = edges[edge_idx].cost;
            int neighbor = edges[edge_idx].y;
            if (dist[neighbor] > dist[node] + cost_c) {
                dist[neighbor] = dist[node] + cost_c;
                parent[neighbor] = node;
                parent_edge[neighbor] = edge_idx;
                if (in_queue[neighbor] == 0) {
                    in_queue[neighbor] = 1;
                    q.push(neighbor);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    int current = sink;
    while (current != source) {
        edges[parent_edge[current]].f++;
        edges[parent_edge[current] ^ 1].f--;
        current = parent[current];
    }
    total_cost += dist[sink];

    graph[from].push_back(edges.size());
    edges.emplace_back(to, capacity, 0, cost);
    graph[to].push_back(edges.size());
    edges.emplace_back(from, 0, 0, -cost);

    cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int x; cin >> x;
        create_edge(source, x, 1, 0);
    }
    int tt = 101;
    for (int i = 0; i < tt; i++)
        create_edge(1 + i * n, sink, k, i * c);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        int x, y; cin >> x >> y;

            create_edge(x + j * n, y + j * n + n, 1, d * (j * 2 + 1));
